from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only cookie payload representing login state."""
    issued_at = str(int(time.time()))
    payload = f"{user_id}.{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode(), payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(f"{payload}.{signature}".encode()).decode()

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": token,
        "httponly": True,
        "secure": True,
        "samesite": "Lax",
    }
